entities.summary: Marzia Basel is a former judge in Afghanistan. During the rule of the Taliban, she secretly educated women in her own home. She is also the founder of the Afghanistan Progressive Law Organization. Marzia Basel was a legal figures from Kabul (b. 1968, Kabul). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
